findings.finding: The load-bearing behavioral claim of this change — that a plan whose only recurring-work trigger is a specific CI provider now DRAWS a finding under project.portability, where before it silently passed — is asserted from the new wording but never empirically exercised in this ticket. The plan pins the detection TEXT (that the string exists) but not the detection EFFECT (that the rule fires on the motivating GitHub-Actions-only case and stays silent on opt-in CI). The eval case that would prove this (a PORT CI case) is explicitly deferred out of scope with no named follow-up ticket, only 'its own live rebar criteria eval attestation run'.
